'''Grayeg Wintozzen''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] near [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He visited the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and was nearly the victim of an attempted assassination by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cadre. Fortunately, a loyal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] found the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]], and escorted him back to the safe confines of the Emperor's Retreat.

==Behind the scenes==
Wintozzen appeared in the "Imperial Theme Park" series of quests in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. After [[September 14]], [[2007]], the quests in which Wintozzen appears were replaced with a different set.
